purpose: Task-compatible learned support selection comparator on identical information and specimen partitions
inner_assignment: sorted remaining specimen index modulo three; same as frozen PFAD
inputs: unchanged normalized per-record source8 and query-context19; padded sources masked
teacher: unchanged training-specimen CT soft anatomy/surface/joint targets
loss: same specimen-anatomy case and class weighted three-head BCE as PFAD
selection: training-only inner specimen-macro joint-label F1; same policy criterion as PFAD; ties prefer higher balanced accuracy, retention and score order, then fewer epochs
reconstruction: unchanged per-record ranking, bounded geometric correction and acquisition-topology meshing
pfad_refit: 12 epochs with original hyperparameters and original frozen outer policy, to obtain models for sensitivity; compare clean replay against archived predictions
statistical_family: four paired point-set endpoints and four paired mesh endpoints; Holm within each representation
scope: retrospective single-resource development; no external-validation claim and no selection on outer results
